body.statement: Can the mixed-support atlas handle \(\mathscr A\) be completed so that, for every fixed finite \((\mathcal W,\mathcal Z)\) and every nonempty \(\mathcal C_A(T)\) or \(\mathcal C_B(T)\), it enumerates all labeled rank-one and rank-two incidence charts, inactive rows, coincident endpoints, residual forests, real algebraic components, and support faces; decides whether \(\tau_C\) agrees within and across them; and returns either an exact target value or a legal target-changing certificate, without using a generic two-copy quantifier-elimination predicate as the classification?
body.justification: This exhaustion and gluing problem is the single load-bearing open mathematical step.
body.gap: Neither causal proxy identification nor NMF rigidity literature supplies a global target-image classification across all boundary components of this labeled cycle.
body.consumer: Solving it turns sufficient regular identification into a complete decision rule for every legal finite anchor-model observable law.
